fetal_movement.title: Fewer baby movements
fetal_movement.what_we_saw: You logged baby movements as "{status}" today.
fetal_movement.how_sure: This is your own log; only an exam can check on the baby.
fetal_movement.advice: Fewer or no movements should not wait until tomorrow. Contact your doctor or midwife now, or go to the hospital.
fetal_movement.contact: Contact your doctor or midwife now; if you can't reach them or it gets worse, call emergency services (115).

kicks.title: Fewer than {target} movements in {minutes} minutes
kicks.what_we_saw: You counted {count} movements in this session; the aim is {target} movements within {minutes} minutes.
kicks.how_sure: This comes from your own count and is not a diagnosis; only an exam can check on the baby.
kicks.advice: Contact your doctor or midwife now. Don't wait for the movements to come back, and don't leave it until tomorrow.

contractions_511.title: Your contractions reached the 5-1-1 pattern
contractions_511.what_we_saw: You timed {count} contractions in the last {minutes} minutes, on average {interval} apart and {duration} long
contractions_511.how_sure: This is worked out from the times you logged; only an exam can confirm that labour has started
contractions_511.advice: It is time to call your maternity unit or midwife and get your hospital bag ready. If your waters break, you are bleeding or the baby moves less, do not wait.
contractions_511.contact: If you have heavy bleeding, constant pain or the baby moves less, call emergency services (115) now.

critical_symptom.title: {symptom} logged
critical_symptom.how_sure: This comes from your own log; only a doctor can tell the cause.
critical_symptom.advice: Don't ignore this symptom. Contact your doctor or midwife now.
critical_symptom.contact: Contact your doctor or midwife now; if you can't reach them or it gets worse, call emergency services (115).

bp_high.title: High blood pressure logged
bp_high.how_sure: One reading from your own log; measuring again at rest helps.
bp_high.advice: A reading of 140/90 or higher in pregnancy should be checked soon. Rest a few minutes, measure again and contact your doctor.
bp_high.contact: Contact your doctor or midwife now; if you can't reach them or it gets worse, call emergency services (115).

severe.title: Your blood pressure is in the severe range for pregnancy
severe.what_we_saw: You logged {systolic}/{diastolic}; 160/110 or higher in pregnancy is urgent.
severe.how_sure: One reading from your own log; with a number like this, don't wait to measure again.
severe.advice: Contact your doctor or midwife now, or go to the hospital. If you have a severe headache, blurred vision, pain high in your belly or trouble breathing, call emergency services (115).
